sources.title: Misinformation Detection using Large Language Models with Explainability
sources.snippet: The rapid spread of misinformation on online platforms undermines trust among individuals and hinders informed decision making. This paper shows an explainable and computationally efficient pipeline to detect misinformation using transformer-based pretrained language models (PLMs).
